test_title: PYST 65: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Colossal sums have ____ wasted on this project.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** "have" **in the sentence indicates that** the* **past participle form *of the verb should be used.
 
• **"Been" **is the correct past participle form that fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct sentence should read: **"Colossal sums have been wasted on this project."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Colossal sums have** been **wasted on this project."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "to" is incorrect as it does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "being" is incorrect as it suggests a continuous action, which is not the case here.
 
• **Option 3: **"be" is incorrect as it does not fit the tense and structure of the sentence.
